criterion: Limit search budgets and apply candidate-count correction across the complete registered search family, including failed and hidden-in-run attempts.
test_result: 6 research-library tests passed; Ruff and targeted mypy passed. Cumulative candidate count and familywise-adjusted per-candidate alpha are exposed from the durable campaign journal.
evidence_scope: Synthetic candidate campaigns and journal recovery tests.
operational_limits: Only attempts submitted to the governed journal can be counted; out-of-band searches require disclosure and inclusion in the family denominator.
Failed, skipped, and aborted candidates remain counted.
The campaign budget is fixed and cannot be expanded after opening.
